item.title: The Vietnam Binh Chau (Chau Tan) Late Tang Wreck
item.description:
📝 The ceramics mix from this wreck is similar to that from the Tang Belitung wreck. The ceramic assemblage from the Binh Chau wreck bears a striking resemblance to the famous Tang-era Belitung wreck. The ewers from the Belitung wreck are stout and upright with angular, squared shoulders.
🔗 Read more: https://www.koh-antique.com/client/tangwreck/tangwreck.html
